Elyx overview

Import a structured exteraGram project into BYgram.

Supported archives

Use .elyx, .eaf or their ZIP variants. BYgram reads metadata and converts the archive to .byplugin at import. Python 3.11 bytecode can be used when the plugin supplies separate metadata.

Where to start
